root_cause_label: All solution variants drop blocks at the gold cell instead of building an adjacent staircase, so the agent can never climb to level 8; position tracking also drifts because moves are applied regardless of game acceptance
one_sentence_failure_summary: Every solution variant the agent produced shares two fatal flaws — blocks are dropped at the gold cell rather than building an adjacent staircase, and internal position tracking updates unconditionally on each returned action rather than only on successful moves — causing infinite execution loops across all ~10 variants with no trial ever completing.
t_err_evidence: Agent writes solution with broken position tracking; uses invalid 'up' fallback move in override
t_commit_evidence: From step 7 onwards, every deployed solution variant shares the same structural errors (wrong staircase logic, broken position tracking) and every test hangs; debug output at step 29 confirms thousands of turns at type:0 level:0 with no win.
t_surface_evidence: node test_runner.js: no new output after 10 seconds, exit_code=-1 — process hangs indefinitely
trigger_explanation: The agent assumed that repeatedly dropping blocks at the coordinates of the gold cell would build a staircase allowing the player to reach level 8, but in game reality the gold is already at level 8 and the player needs an adjacent staircase of incrementally higher blocks to climb to it. This false premise was never corrected across ~10 solution rewrites.
